phase: B2-only formal geometry and surface visibility
status: geometry complete; shader reference checks owned by render agent
coordinate_convention: OpenCV c2w right/down/forward; axial depth meters; zero depth/object0/triangle-1 means mesh miss (including environment sky)
stable_surface_identity: object ID + global triangulated face ID + object-local point/barycentric; rigid object matrices at all60times
alpha_definition: 4x4 regular subpixel first-hit semantic foreground fraction, finite-AA geometry Oracle; reference map alpha is1ray only
recovery: same local surface point first-hit-visible inside another actual input image; current excluded, remaining12 only
classification: for each actual observing s also test motion-only(geometry s,target s,camera t) and parallax-only(geometry t,target t,camera s); parallax-sufficient priority; remaining actual-recovered=motion-required, pure-motion/mixed/overlap ray flags separately retained
pixel_masks: union over16 aperture rays; drop any pixel with residual ray; parallax priority makes display regions disjoint; primary mask is actual recovered total, never inferred from object ID
hidden_definition: central first hit is closer in range by>1e-4m; coplanar ID ties are not hidden
peeling: first exclude current central blocking object b; if still blocked by c exclude{b,c}; require same target object+hit point<=1e-4m; self-occlusion/removed target remains residual
reference_geometry: fNNN-exclude-id[-id].npz follows required-exclusions; shader camera-invisible reference colors generated separately preserving shadows/reflections/indirect light
deep_background: fNNN-background.npz removes all declared foreground geometrically only for shared Cfill depth; never presented as all-hidden appearance
limitations: finite K16 geometry and4x4 alpha, not continuous visibility integral
ray and pixel recovery causes can overlap; raw boolean evidence kept
one controlled main scene and low-CoC control, no cross-scene inference
